atoms.title: The Guitar
atoms.b: The guitar is probably the most well-known plucked instrument and normally has six strings.
atoms.sound: The guitar is probably the most well-known plucked instrument and normally has six strings

atoms.title: The Harp
atoms.b: The harp is a large plucked instrument with many strings. All strings of a harp are different lengths, and therefore each has its own unique sound.
atoms.sound: The harp is a large plucked instrument with many strings. All strings of a harp are different lengths, and therefore each has its own unique sound.

atoms.title: The Banjo
atoms.b: This is a banjo. The body of a banjo is round and looks a bit like a drum.
atoms.sound: This is a banjo. The body of a banjo is round and looks a bit like a drum.

atoms.title: The Ukulele
atoms.b: The ukulele looks like a small guitar with only four strings. The ukulele is played in the same way as a guitar but has a higher sound since its strings are much shorter.
